description:
## 1.36.0-dev.117 (2026-08-11)

- Reddit: search every visible Compose host for the nearest parent or child comment before scrolling, preventing skipped comments.
- Reddit: invoke scrolling on the virtual Compose semantics node that actually owns the post-detail scroll action.
- Reddit: resume selection at the newly visible boundary only after a confirmed native scroll.
- Reddit: preserve logical comment identity and highlighting across Compose host replacement and viewport boundaries.
- Reddit: retain collapse/expand behavior and oversized preview crash protection.
